'''Peg Shar I''' was an [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] that occupied the first [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="CL" /> in the [[Peg Shar system/Legends|Peg Shar system]]. It was a part of the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]],<ref name="KashyyykRegion" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Lesser Lantillian Route/Legends|Lesser Lantillian Route]] linked it to [[Pusat Station]] and the [[Saari Ha system]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="32 BBY">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] establishes that Peg Shar I was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the events of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified senator (Peg Shar I)/Legends|senator]] represented Peg Shar I in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the Republic, the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] had an office on a level below the offices used by [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] senatorial delegations.<ref name="CL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Peg Shar I was introduced in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Peg Shar [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Peg Shar I, in grid square R-8.<ref name="TEA" />
